_comment: Optional opt-in hook. Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json hooks.SessionEnd. First handler reminds you to capture durable memories (does NOT auto-extract — heuristic-only and explicitly user-driven). Second handler incrementally reindexes Claude Code session transcripts so rekol search can surface them without a separate cron. Third handler nudges (only when overdue>0) to re-confirm durable always-current memory.

hooks.command: if [ -n "${REKOL_HOME:-$MEMORY_HOME}" ]; then echo '[rekol] session ended — if you learned something durable, run `rekol capture` (see the memory skill)'; fi
